elements.name: Pisces
elements.text: Pisces: dreams and empathy, a receptive depth that dissolves the boundary between self and other.

elements.name: Moon face
elements.text: The face in the moon: our hidden, intimate side, watching from stillness as the night deepens.

elements.name: Twin fish riders
elements.text: Twin figures riding mirrored fish: the two equal, opposing halves of Pisces, guided toward our depths.
